(679)yid bzhin 'khor lo la brten pa'i mtha' brten bkra shis tshe yi dbang bskur ba ni/bdag mdun bum pa tha mi dad par bsgrubs nas thun mthar tshe 'gugs pa

tei:div.tei:p: yid bzhin 'khor lo la brten pa'i mtha' brten bkra shis tshe yi dbang bskur ba ni/ bdag mdun bum pa tha mi dad par bsgrubs nas thun mthar tshe 'gugs pa la/ mda' dar g.yab te/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ shar phyogs ri bo ta la nas/ tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo ma/ sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs dang bcas/ 'khor dang bcas pa thugs dam bskul/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab cing*/ pad+ma dkar po grangs med par/ sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'jin dang*/ rig sngags grub pa bye ba (680)stong*/ kun kyang chags pa'i nyams dang ldan/ 'jig rten kun tu khyab par spros/ bla tshe chad nyams yar ba dang*/ brkus dang 'phrog dang stobs gzhoms pa'i/ nyams pa thams cad sor chud cing*/ pha rol sde dngag stobs phrogs nas/ rang gi bla tshe yar ba dang*/ 'byung lnga skye 'gro'i tshe dang bcud/ dwangs ma'i 'od kyi rnam par bsdus/ snying po sngags la sib sib thim/ 'chi ba med pa'i gnas thob gyur/ zhes dang*/ dngos dbang dngos la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ (681)ho/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo bdag la dgongs/ sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pas na/ de phyir rgyal ba'i yum du grags/ sgrol ma'i tshe dbang stsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/ lan du/ ho/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob par/ dam tshig sdom pa la gnas na/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ tshe yi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ zhes dang*/ skyabs 'gro/ āḥ skye ba med pa chos kyi sku/ nges pa sogs dang*/ sems bskyed/ āḥ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun (682) sogs// tshogs bsags pa/ āḥ 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs sogs/ dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ma/ dam tshig pa gsal ba/ āḥ gdod nas rnam dag byang chub sogs nas/ ye nas lhun gyis grub par gsal/ bar btang*/ spyan 'dren/ āḥ mkhyen brtse ye shes sogs nas/ dṛ sh+ya ho bar dang*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par byas nas tshe 'bugs btang*/

thon mar sku bum pa'i dbang ni/ oṃ/ 'chi med bde chen bum pa na/ zag med ye shes bdud rtsis gtams/ rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ skye 'chi bral ba'i dbang (683)thob shog rtsa sngags sham/ ma ma ā gur puṇ+yai dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bum pa spyi bor bzhag gsung bdud rtsi'i dbang ni/ āḥ gnyug ma mi shigs nā da'i dbyangs/ rtag dang dngos po mtha' las 'das/ sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par sbyor/ 'gags med gsung gi dbang thob shog sngags dang bdud rtsi sbyin/ thugs ril bu'i dbangani/ hūm̐ḥ rnam par mi rtog gzung 'jin bral/ spros bral zlum po rgyal ba'i thugs/ dbang bcu stobs bcu mi 'jigs rdzogs/ 'phags ma'i thugs dang gnyis (684)med shog rtsa sngags bcas ril bu sbyin/ rjes kyi bya ba tshe sba zhing skye 'chi med par rgyas gdab pa ni/ āḥ spros pas srid zhi'i tshe bsod 'gugs/ bsdus pas mi shigs gnyug ma'i gshis/ sku gsung thugs ldan rdo rje'i bdag 'phags ma'i thugs su rgyas gdab pas/ stobs dang gzi byin phun sum tshogs/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis/ srung dang skyob dang phan bde byed/ gang du gnas kyang bkra shis 'gyur/ rtsa sngags dang*/ badz+ra kā wā tsi rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ rdau rjes rgyas gdab po/ bkra shis dang dam tshig khas blang sogs spyi dang mthun no/ ces pa'ang bla ma dam pa dpal ldan gyi ngor chos kyi bdag pos so/// /
